item.title: British pop-punks Goldstate jump in at the “Deep End” sign to Manic Kat Records
item.description: Emerging pop-punk crew Goldstate have dropped their brand new single, “Deep End”. The heart-on-sleeve anthem nods to the early ’10’s scene, with driving guitars and compelling hooks adorning the band’s fourth single to date. The Leicester outfit have also inked a deal with Manic Kat Records. item.title: Breaking Benjamin’s Keith Wallen Shares New Single “A Thin Line”
item.description: BREAKING BENJAMIN GUITARIST KEITH WALLEN KICKS OFF 2026 WITH NEW SOLO SINGLE “A THIN LINE” — LISTEN BREAKING BENJAMIN guitarist KEITH WALLEN has kicked off 2026 with the new single “A Thin Line.” The song’s gentle acoustic guitar strumming is accompanied by Wallen’s emotive, room-filling vocals.
